name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three unnamed routines in order and returns. It is a sequencing stub with no logic of its own.

name: step_random_state_and_shift
description: Multiplies a 16-bit state word in a structure by 31415, adds one and stores the result back. It returns that value shifted right by the count held in its register, which is a linear congruential style generator step.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: install_interrupt_handlers_and_vectors
description: Saves four global values and, when a flag is zero, points four globals at handler routines. It then stores handler addresses into memory slots and makes calls through the library base, and the library calls shown are exec's AddIntServer and SetIntVector.

name: remove_interrupt_handlers_and_restore
description: Makes two unnamed library calls, sets two register values of 1920 and 15, and makes further calls through the library base that the facts identify as exec's RemIntServer and SetIntVector. It finishes by restoring the four saved global values.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: accumulate_mouse_motion_counters
description: Reads the mouse movement register and the fire-button bit on each call and adds the horizontal and vertical movement since the last sample to two clamped counters. name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Decodes a byte from the keyboard serial register by inverting and rotating it. It either updates a modifier flag for key codes 96 and 97, or for other key-down codes translates the key through a lookup table into a wrap-around buffer.

name: set_or_clear_flag_two
description: Sets the value 2 in a global flag word when the byte passed in its register has bit 7 clear, and clears that value otherwise.

name: set_or_clear_flag_one
description: Sets the value 1 in a global flag word when the byte passed in its register has bit 7 clear, and clears that value otherwise.

name: or_input_into_flag_word
description: ORs its input register into a global flag word without clearing any bits, then returns.

name: append_scaled_entry_to_buffer
description: When the input byte has bit 7 clear, it reads a table entry at four times the byte's value, subtracts one if a flag is set, and appends the result to a wrap-around buffer while advancing its write index. It does nothing when bit 7 is set.

name: check_ring_buffer_empty
description: Returns zero when the read and write indices of a ring buffer are equal, meaning empty, and minus one otherwise.

name: read_ring_buffer_byte_blocking
description: Waits until the read and write indices of a ring buffer differ, then returns the byte at the read index and advances that index with wraparound.

name: service_audio_channel_zero_interrupt
description: Acknowledges the audio channel zero interrupt request by writing its bit to the interrupt request register. While a countdown global is nonzero it decrements it and re-enables the interrupt, and when it reaches zero it resets the countdown to 65535 and writes one to a hardware register.

name: disable_audio_channel_zero_dma
description: Decrements the countdown shared with the channel zero interrupt routine and writes the value one to the DMA control register, which without bit 15 set disables audio channel zero.

name: service_audio_channel_one_interrupt
description: Acknowledges the audio channel one interrupt request through the interrupt request register. While its countdown global is nonzero it decrements it and re-enables the interrupt, and when the countdown reaches zero it resets the countdown to 65535 and writes two to a hardware register.

name: disable_audio_channel_one_dma
description: Decrements the countdown shared with the channel one interrupt routine and writes the value two to the DMA control register, which without bit 15 set disables audio channel one.

name: service_audio_channel_two_interrupt
description: Acknowledges the audio channel two interrupt request through the interrupt request register. While its countdown global is nonzero it decrements it and re-enables the interrupt, and when the countdown reaches zero it resets the countdown to 65535 and writes four to a hardware register.

name: disable_audio_channel_two_dma
description: Decrements the countdown shared with the channel two interrupt routine and writes the value four to the DMA control register, which without bit 15 set disables audio channel two.

name: service_audio_channel_three_interrupt
description: Acknowledges the audio channel three interrupt request through the interrupt request register. While its countdown global is nonzero it decrements it and re-enables the interrupt, and when the countdown reaches zero it resets it to 65535 and writes eight to a hardware register.

name: disable_audio_channel_three_dma
description: Decrements the countdown shared with the channel three interrupt routine and writes the value eight to the DMA control register, which without bit 15 set disables audio channel three.

name: ramp_audio_volume_by_mask
description: Writes the current volume value to the volume register of each audio channel whose bit is set in a mask, then steps the stored volume one unit up or down. It clears the direction state when the volume reaches its lower or upper limit.

name: accumulate_cia_timer_ticks
description: Reads the CIA-A time-of-day low register and adds four times the change since the previous sample to a running total. It corrects for wraparound when the new reading is far below the old one.

name: allocate_aligned_buffer_offset
description: Advances a pointer by its argument rounded up to an even count, and returns the previous position plus a fixed offset if the new position stays below a limit, otherwise minus one.

name: wait_with_budget_then_cleanup
description: Chooses one of three byte budgets based on a flag, then polls an unnamed check and reduces the budget by 1000 on each failed pass. Once the budget is exhausted it makes cleanup calls, including dos Write and exec AllocMem among its library calls, and returns the result of the last one; the referenced text is 'Nu=|'.

name: build_colormap_buffer_layout
description: Gets a colour map through the graphics library and fills in its sub-results, returning minus one on the first failure. It then lays out seven buffer pointers at 3200-byte intervals from a base block and resets several counters.

name: run_pit_back_setup_once
description: Calls an unnamed setup routine the first time it runs and then sets two state globals so that it does not run again. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDArtWork/PitBack.

name: run_mirror_art_setup_once
description: Calls an unnamed setup routine the first time it runs and then sets two state globals so that it does not run again. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDArtWork/Mirror.

name: record_half_length_in_table
description: Writes a three-longword record into the table slot selected by its input index, then calls an unnamed routine for a length. When the length is positive it advances a running total, stores half the length in the record and returns it, and returns minus one otherwise or when the total passes a limit.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else, reporting failure to any caller.

name: run_sound_setup_then_optional
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then calls two more when a flag is set. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDData/Sounds.

name: run_optional_sound_setup_pair
description: Calls two unnamed routines only when a flag is set and otherwise returns. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDData/Sounds2.

name: rebase_table_entries_by_address
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then adds a base address to the first longword of each of 30 records spaced 12 bytes apart. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDData/Sounds3.

name: rebase_table_entries_inline
description: Adds the input address to the first longword of each of 30 records spaced 12 bytes apart, without calling any other routine.

name: toggle_buffer_top_bits
description: Gets a length from an unnamed routine and toggles bit 7 of each byte in a buffer of that length, then makes one final call.

name: read_pair_store_or_fail
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a pair of values and fails with minus one when the high value is zero. Otherwise it stores the high value in a global, makes a series of unnamed calls, and returns the combined result.

name: read_file_triple_then_close
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a pair of values and fails with minus one when the high value is zero. Otherwise it stores that value, calls the dos library's Read entry three times, then Seek and Close, and returns the two results.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: read_demo_lap_or_fail
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a handle, and if the handle is nonzero it stores it and makes two dos library calls for Read and Close, then returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus one. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDData/Demo.Lap.

name: load_high_scores_or_fail
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a handle, and when it is nonzero stores the handle, makes two dos Read calls and a Close, then calls one more unnamed routine and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus one. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDData/HighScores.Tab.

name: save_high_scores_or_fail
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a handle, and when it is nonzero stores it, writes data with dos Write twice when a marker byte equals an asterisk, then closes the file and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus one. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDData/HighScores.Tab.

name: xor_buffer_with_fixed_key
description: XORs 220 bytes of a buffer, starting at a global pointer, with the value 42 in place. The routine has no other effect.

name: read_twelve_records_then_close
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a handle, and if it is nonzero stores the handle, calls the dos Read entry twelve times, then Close, and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus one.

name: read_nine_records_then_close
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a handle, and if it is nonzero stores the handle, calls the dos Read entry nine times, then Close, and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus one.

name: read_file_and_offset_table
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a handle. When the handle is nonzero it reads data through dos Read calls, adds a global value to each longword of a table, reads more and closes the file, returning zero; otherwise it clears a count global and returns minus one.

name: copy_name_and_store_lookup
description: Copies eight characters from a global record into a fixed buffer, converting each space to a zero byte. It then calls an unnamed routine and stores its result in a table slot chosen by a global index. The referenced text is the disk path prefix DF0:PDBOBS/.

name: store_result_if_index_valid
description: Calls an unnamed routine and stores its result in the table slot selected by its input index, but only when that index is nonnegative.

name: copy_name_and_call
description: Copies eight characters from a global record into a fixed buffer, converting each space to a zero byte, then makes one unnamed call. The referenced text is the disk path prefix DF0:PDBOBS/.

name: load_bob_library_in_sequence
description: Makes a long chain of unnamed calls and stops at the first one that returns a negative value. The dos Close entry is among the library calls, and the referenced path is DF0:PDArtwork/BobLib. The pseudo-code is truncated, so only the chain structure is recoverable.

name: store_timing_delta_then_call
description: Stores the difference between two globals in a third global, then makes two unnamed calls and returns the result of the first. The referenced texts are DF0:PDBobs/TopRacer0 and DF0:PDBobs/TopRacer0TP.

name: store_timing_delta_and_store
description: Stores the difference between two globals in a third global, then calls an unnamed routine and stores its result in a fourth global. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDBobs/Inset.

name: set_offsets_and_load_panels
description: Saves two globals, then either sets them from a base value plus 14000 and 16000 or computes a difference, and calls two unnamed routines whose results are stored in globals. It restores the saved values before returning. The referenced texts are DF0:PDArtWork/TVBack, DF0:PDBobs/Banner and DF0:PDBobs/TeeVee.

name: load_bob_library_two
description: Makes a chain of unnamed calls and returns the result of a dos Close when every step succeeds. Otherwise it closes the file and returns minus one. The referenced path is DF0:PDArtwork/BobLib2.

name: dispatch_command_stream_until_end
description: Reads command values from an unnamed routine in a loop until one is negative. The value 12345 preserves a field around a call, values from 2 to 4 get an extra call, and every other value makes the standard calls.

name: fill_grid_from_row_offsets
description: Fills a four-row by sixteen-column table of longwords, where each entry is the row index times four plus a 16-bit value taken from a second table at a stride of 24 bytes. It has no other effect.

name: store_pointer_pair_and_call
description: Stores its two register arguments into a pair of globals, then makes one unnamed call.

name: store_args_read_or_close
description: Stores its two register arguments in globals and calls an unnamed routine. If that returns nonzero it stores the handle, makes a further unnamed call, then calls dos Close and returns its result; otherwise it calls dos Close and returns zero.

name: read_frame_and_combine_bitplanes
description: Reads frame header and pixel data with dos Read and Seek, sets up a bitmap with graphics InitBitMap and a structure of four bitplanes, and then ORs the four planes word by word into one plane. It returns the frame structure, zero when no frame was built, or minus one on failure.

name: or_combine_frame_planes
description: ORs the four bitplanes of the current frame word by word into a single plane, using the plane pointers stored in the frame structure, and returns without work when no frame is present.

name: find_iff_chunk_tag_index
description: Compares the four-byte value at its input address against a table of six four-byte tags, which the referenced text lists as FORM, ILBM, BMHD, CMAP, GRAB and BODY. It returns the index of the first match, or minus one when none matches.

name: emit_rows_optional_extra_call
description: Loops over a fixed run of rows, calling an unnamed routine four times per row and a fifth time when a global value exceeds four. Its callers are not named.

name: unpack_run_length_bytes
description: Decodes a packed byte stream until its count runs out. A negative control byte repeats the next byte, a positive one copies the following bytes literally, and the value 128 is skipped; when a global flag is clear it copies words straight through instead.

name: set_cockpit_mode_and_call
description: When a flag is clear it calls one unnamed routine and returns. When the flag is set it sets a state global to one and calls a second unnamed routine. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDArtWork/Cockpit.

name: advance_cockpit_offset_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then adds 116 to a global offset. The referenced text is the disk path DF0:PDArtWork/Cockpit.

name: fill_byte_pair_then_words
description: Writes a byte value from an unnamed routine into two destination pointers for 65536 passes, then enters a loop that writes words from another unnamed routine. The decompiled code shows no exit from the word loop.

name: init_bitmap_planes_with_stride
description: Clears a block through the graphics library and initialises a bitmap, then, if the count returned is positive, stores four plane pointers spaced by a plane size held in a global. It returns zero on success and minus one otherwise.

name: build_view_and_viewport_lists
description: Builds the display view and viewport lists through the graphics library. It gets a colour map, initialises a rastport and viewport, makes and merges copper lists, and loads the view, with the viewport width set to 320 and two globals set to 200 and 8000.

name: rebuild_viewport_and_load_view
description: Frees the old copper lists, makes a viewport with width 320 and merges its copper lists through the graphics library, then loads the view. It sets two display-mode globals to one and five along the way.

name: make_viewport_and_load_view
description: Sets a field to 65535, sets two display-mode globals to one and five, and then calls the graphics library's MakeVPort, MrgCop and LoadView entries.

name: load_view_with_mode_four
description: Sets two display-mode globals to zero and four, then calls the graphics library's LoadView entry.

name: update_frame_timing_swap_state
description: Computes the change in a counter since the last frame and clamps it between 8 and 50, storing the result in a structure. It then toggles a state word and swaps saved pointer pairs between two sets of globals.

name: load_view_and_clear_flag
description: Calls the graphics library's LoadView entry through the library base, then clears a flag byte.

name: release_copper_lists_and_wait
description: Copies four saved values into working globals, calls unnamed routines chosen by a state byte, then loads the view and waits for the bottom of the display. It frees copper and viewport lists through the graphics library on the way.

name: make_viewport_and_merge_cops
description: Clears two pointer globals and two saved values, then calls the graphics library's MakeVPort and MrgCop entries and stores the results in saved globals.

name: make_viewport_and_merge_second
description: Clears two pointer globals, calls the graphics library's MakeVPort and MrgCop entries, and saves the results into a second pair of globals.

name: swap_view_copper_lists
description: Copies a saved pair into working globals, then runs the graphics library calls that free, rebuild, merge and load the view, waiting for the bottom of the display in between. It frees the old copper list where the pointers changed.

name: run_hunk_compare_frame_loop
description: Runs a loop that advances a frame counter and, every eighth pass when one field is zero, calls unnamed routines that depend on a second field. The decompiled body is incomplete, though it compares values with AmigaDOS hunk type codes.

name: reset_flag_run_four_calls
description: Clears a global flag word and then makes four unnamed calls in sequence, with no other logic.

name: forward_registers_and_return_pair
description: Makes one unnamed call, then a second that passes its register state through, and returns the values of the first two registers as a 64-bit result.

name: checksum_memory_byte_range
description: Adds up the bytes of memory from a fixed start address to a fixed end address and returns the 32-bit total, so it works as a simple byte checksum over that range.

name: store_result_at_struct_offset
description: Calls an unnamed routine and stores its result at longword offset 20 of a structure addressed by a register.

name: compare_hunk_value_and_loop
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns early when its result equals a stored value; otherwise it enters a frame counter loop like its neighbour. The decompiled body is incomplete, though it compares values with AmigaDOS hunk type codes.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: store_fixed_longword_constant
description: Stores a fixed 32-bit constant into a global and returns, with no other effect.

name: check_original_disk_in_drive
description: Compares a value from an unnamed routine with a stored value and, when they differ, shows the prompts 'PUT YOUR BACK-UP DISK IN DRIVE A.' and 'YOUR ORIGINAL DISK MUST BE IN DRIVE A.' before checking again. It sets a status word to minus one if the second check still fails.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two unnamed routines in order and returns. It is a sequencing stub with no logic of its own.

name: run_due_timed_routine
description: When a count is pending, a gate flag is clear, and a timer has reached a due value or a force flag is set, it records the current timer and runs an unnamed routine with the next due value. The gate is held while the routine runs.

name: forward_call_stub
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns. It is a forwarding stub with no other logic.

name: copy_table_word_into_field
description: Reads a 16-bit value from a global table at an index taken from a structure field, and stores it in another field of the same structure.

name: forward_call_stub
description: Makes one call to an unnamed routine and returns. It is a forwarding stub with no other logic.

name: copy_table_word_into_field
description: Reads a 16-bit value from a global table at an index taken from a structure field, and stores it in another field of the same structure.

name: store_three_biased_values
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times, each time storing the result minus 256 into successive word fields of a structure.

name: random_scaled_by_input
description: Advances the same 16-bit state as the step_random_state routine, multiplies its low 15 bits by the input value, and returns the high word of twice that product.

name: blit_clamped_offset_bitmap
description: When one field is zero, it clamps a second field to between minus five and five and passes that amount with fixed rectangle values to the graphics library's BltBitMap entry through the library base. It then makes one more library call.

name: call_with_swapped_buffer_pairs
description: Saves two stored pointer pairs, swaps in an alternate pair, calls an unnamed routine, and then restores both pairs.

name: blit_fixed_rectangle_bitmap
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value, then makes a graphics library BltBitMap call with fixed rectangle and minterm values, and finishes by calling a second unnamed routine.

name: process_linked_entry_list
description: Sets a field to 200, and when a flag is clear and another field is zero it makes an optional unnamed call. It then calls an unnamed routine for each node of a linked list with fixed parameters, and sets the field to 150 afterwards.

name: loop_routine_over_count
description: Saves a pointer field, sets a counter field to zero, and calls an unnamed routine once for each step of a countdown from a stored count. It then restores the saved pointer and sets a field to 19.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes the integer square root of its input register by a bitwise search over powers of two, returning the largest value whose square does not exceed the input. Negative inputs produce no result.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: send_serial_byte_when_idle
description: Waits until a pending flag global clears, then sets it and writes the input byte with bit 8 set to the serial data register. The writes use the serial transmit path only.

name: enable_serial_transmit_interrupt
description: Clears a pending flag and enables the transmit-buffer-empty interrupt through the interrupt enable register, using a set-bit write.

name: init_serial_state_and_period
description: Sets the serial period register to 185 and clears several serial state fields. It then sets the enable bits for the transmit and receive-buffer interrupts.

name: service_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Acknowledges the receive-buffer interrupt and reads the received byte from the serial data register. Outside a command state it stores the byte in an 80-entry ring buffer, and in a command state it decodes the byte through a lookup table and updates state fields.

name: store_field_and_enable_receive
description: Stores its second input word in a structure field, then writes the enable pattern for the receive-buffer-full interrupt to the interrupt enable register.

name: decode_serial_command_byte
description: Turns the received byte into a table index by subtracting 42, then sets state fields according to whether the table entry is empty, positive or negative. It re-enables the receive-buffer interrupt afterwards.

name: reset_serial_decoder_state
description: Clears several serial decoder fields, sets one to minus one, and re-enables the receive-buffer interrupt.

name: append_serial_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores the byte read from the serial data register into an 80-entry ring buffer at the current index, advances the index with wraparound, and re-enables the receive interrupt.

name: check_serial_buffer_empty
description: Returns zero when the serial read and write indices are equal, meaning no byte is waiting, and minus one otherwise.

name: read_serial_byte_blocking
description: Waits until the serial ring buffer holds a byte, then returns that byte and advances the read index with wraparound at 80 entries.

name: service_serial_output_state
description: When an output state field is nonzero, it clears the pending state and runs unnamed routines to send the queued bytes. It returns early when a second field is set.

name: receive_serial_block_with_timeout
description: Reads a serial byte through an unnamed routine and, for command codes, enters a loop with a 500-step countdown that calls unnamed routines to receive data. The decompiled body is partly truncated, so the exact steps after the loop start are not recoverable.

name: poll_up_to_forty_times
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly for up to 40 steps, calling a second unnamed routine after each nonzero result, and stops at the first zero result.

name: fill_marked_buffer_and_send
description: Stores a flag from a structure, adds 42 to the first byte of a buffer, and then loops over a count while waiting for a pending flag and calling an unnamed routine on each step. It makes two more calls when a structure field is nonzero.

name: fill_buffer_until_deadline
description: Records a deadline from a stored offset and a counter, then writes a byte from a structure field into a buffer while repeatedly calling an unnamed routine. It stops when a state byte equals four.

name: set_state_four_and_call
description: Sets a global state word to four and makes one unnamed call.

name: run_serial_protocol_state_machine
description: Dispatches on a state byte and a command global to run one serial protocol step, setting timeout fields and calling unnamed routines for each state. The decompiled body is partly truncated, so only the dispatch structure is fully recoverable.

name: copy_state_fields_to_globals
description: Sets a mode byte to one, or to eleven when either of two structure fields is nonzero. It then copies six structure fields into global locations and makes one unnamed call.

name: wait_for_state_then_restore
description: Saves a field, clears it, and sets a mode byte to eight. It then polls an unnamed routine until a state byte reaches 24 or a window of 800 time units passes, restores the saved field, and returns the state byte.

name: initialise_mode_twenty_six_state
description: Saves a field, clears it, and loads a mode byte of 26 with values taken from a pointer table. It sets a timer field to 2400, calls an unnamed routine, marks another field as minus one, and then restores the saved field.

name: copy_nine_bytes_if_negative
description: When a field is negative it copies nine bytes from a constant table into a block of globals. The referenced text lists several names.

name: update_mode_transition_by_field
description: When a field is nonzero it sets a mode byte to 29, calls unnamed routines, and clears two fields. Otherwise it runs a series of unnamed calls and, when a check value is non-negative, sets a timer field to 5 and a state field to one before one more call.

name: poll_input_with_timeouts
description: Polls an input byte inside nested loops with 1000 and 2000 time-unit windows, calling unnamed routines to process each result. The referenced text lists several names, and the decompiled body is partly truncated.

name: wait_twelve_vertical_blanks
description: Calls the graphics library's WaitTOF entry twelve times, waiting for twelve vertical blanks.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately and does nothing. Its callers are not named.

name: compute_clamped_distance_value
description: Makes one unnamed call, then returns 60 minus the absolute value of a structure field scaled down by 256, or zero when that value exceeds 60.

name: process_hunk_compare_block
description: A long routine that compares values with AmigaDOS hunk type codes and processes several linked blocks with unnamed calls. The decompiler removed several unreachable blocks and the body is partly truncated, so only its general structure is recoverable.

name: initialise_three_offset_fields
description: When a state field is zero it sets motion defaults of 10 and 20, clears several fields, and stores three values from unnamed calls into offset fields, each minus 64.

name: initialise_fixed_offset_fields
description: When a state field is zero it sets motion defaults of 10 and 20, clears several fields, and stores the fixed values minus 80, zero and zero into three offset fields.

name: set_signed_speed_from_flags
description: Sets motion fields to 10, 1, 100, 2 and 20, and clears two more fields. The signs of the speed values are chosen by two bits of a flag word.

name: initialise_offset_fields_with_bias
description: When a state field is zero, it sets that state and a timer, stores three values from unnamed calls each minus 255, and stores a fourth value from another call, negated when it is below 3.

name: update_warning_status_flags
description: Advances two counters by 3 and 7 and sets status flag values 32, 16 or 8 in a flag word when each counter reaches its limit, then calls two unnamed routines. The referenced text is WARNING-.

name: register_entry_with_pointer_list
description: Sets two fields to minus one and zero, makes two unnamed calls, sets a state field to one, and stores the structure's address in a global list pointer.

name: store_scaled_table_offsets
description: Looks up two table entries by index, scales each one with a multiply and a divide by a register value, and stores the resulting offsets into two buffers at positions set by a base field.

name: fill_three_table_columns
description: When a flag word is zero it sets the flag, stores the input value in two fields, then for each table entry calls unnamed routines and stores each result minus 63 into three table columns. It finishes by writing three further words from the input registers.

name: step_table_motion_entries
description: Loops over table entries, adding a second set of entries to each one and decrementing a list counter when it is negative. The decompiled body is long and partly truncated.

name: update_row_table_entries
description: Advances a field by 200, then loops over 200 rows, updating table entries and writing a value from a structure field into each row through six unnamed calls. The decompiled body is truncated, so only the outer structure is recoverable.
